utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Let us very briefly take the opportunity in the framework of Status Conference of about five minutes to address the remaining issues. We started, and now in this framework, it can be done. The Office of the Prosecutor withdraw the 94 bis motion. It was accepted by the Defence, and it's accepted by the Chamber. Therefore, this is declared moot. Then there was the request for hearing an additional witness. And we wanted to hear the observations by the Defence on this issue.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. I raise the objection for two reasons, and I can share with the Court that there may be additional reasons, although it would be premature, since we did not receive from the OTP the motion that they are either filing today or had filed today. But what we did receive was a copy of a statement taken from a witness which they would like to call. We think it's late in the procedure. We think it causes undue prejudice to the Defence and Dr. Stakic specifically. This witness has never been mentioned in any other proceedings before, to our knowledge, and the statement itself contains a list of videos that I have asked the OTP to present, which would make a complete list. We do not have that list attached to the statement. I'm confident we will get it, though. And for those reasons, and for not having the motion itself, but just hearing from the OTP that it would take an hour to an hour and a half, we would object and state that it's too late for them now to be calling witnesses in this matter and interviewing witnesses as their witness statement reflects as late as September 17th of 2002.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: We have to decide on this issue when we have received --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: We will decide on this motion when we have received it in writing. Another point of concern, and may we therefore go for a moment in private session, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SCHOMBURG
utterances.text: Thank you. The trial will resume as such on Monday, 9.30.
